note: Both sets extract a large number of duplicate claims and struggle with some of the specific values. Set A incorrectly assigns 30% to the cooling load and misreads a scatter plot point (-110 °C for Harrison at 51 atomic %). Set B incorrectly assigns 2900 grams to the martensite phase and misbinds the 15-20 C temperature range to the building envelope. Set B is slightly better as it avoids spamming as many guessed scatter plot points.
